description: This file defines extension functions and composable helpers related to analytics events within the Android application, specifically for logging screen views and news resource openings.
external_methods: Loggability of logEvent (assumed external method based on association)

methods.name: logScreenView
methods.description: Logs a screen view event with the provided screen name.

methods.name: logNewsResourceOpened
methods.description: Logs an event indicating a news resource was opened, with its ID.

methods.name: TrackScreenViewEvent
methods.description: A composable that records a screen view event when composed, using a disposable effect.
